label: BRD4::NUTM1

sections.text: BRD4 encodes a BET-family chromatin reader that regulates transcriptional elongation.
NUTM1 encodes a normally testis-enriched protein that interacts with the acetyltransferase p300.

The fusion recruits NUTM1 into a BRD-associated chromatin complex and promotes p300-dependent acetylation, maintaining proliferation and blocking differentiation. BRD4::NUTM1 forms large hyperacetylated chromatin domains.

NUT carcinoma is clinically aggressive. In a retrospective 124-patient cohort, nonthoracic BRD4-fused tumors had worse survival than nonthoracic BRD3/NSD3-fused tumors, while thoracic disease had the poorest outcomes.
